projects.name: IPO Tracker & Analysis Platform
projects.description: Backend system tracking IPO subscription data and Grey Market Premium (GMP) in near real-time. Scheduled ingestion every 30 minutes, time-series snapshots to analyze demand momentum, trend-based logic to detect accelerating vs cooling demand, and APIs exposing current state, history, and a final recommendation.

projects.name: LSM Tree Storage Engine
projects.description: Custom LSM Tree storage engine implementing MemTable, SSTables, and Bloom filters, achieving 3,500+ writes/sec with 97% test coverage. Explores the concepts behind systems like RocksDB and Cassandra. Includes a live visualizer.

projects.name: OpenInference CLI
projects.description: Hardware-aware package manager for local AI models. Profiles CPU, RAM, GPU, disk, and OS, then recommends models from a 150+ model catalog that will realistically run on the machine. Guided setup wizard, unattended mode, and Ollama as the inference backend. Published on npm, ~11,100 downloads/month, MIT licensed.
